items.title: Claude Code 2.1.325 released
items.text: Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded · Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook · Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run /rewind and change the message, or run /clear · Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed git checkout, git stash or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in .claude

items.title: California AG sues OpenAI over the Hugging Face attack, alleging it was one of 80+ incidents result…
items.text: California AG sues OpenAI over the Hugging Face attack, alleging it was one of 80+ incidents resulting from OpenAI testing AI models without adequate safeguards. California Attorney General Rob Bonta is suing OpenAI over the cyberattack its rogue AI agents launched this summer against the tech platform Hugging Face.

items.title: Harvard study: just 403 US data centers operational between May 2024 and April 2025 consumed as muc…
items.text: Harvard study: just 403 US data centers operational between May 2024 and April 2025 consumed as much electricity annually as the state of Michigan. New Harvard research shows that data-center power demand is outstripping states—and that doesn't even include facilities with off-grid gas plants.
